title: Your brand enters the cutscene
timingStatus: Provisional three-second beats. Measure the approved voice and adjust shot boundaries without clipping words.
generationMode: Built-in ImageGen, two contact sheets. Still concepts only.

locks.character: Existing penthouse avatar from October 19. Blond braids, warm brown skin, same face, build, hairline and adult appearance.
locks.world: Existing PS2 penthouse, tan chair, glass table, dusk skyline and game lighting.
locks.voice: Existing approved penthouse voice reference. Do not select a new voice or generate a new read before approval and quote.
locks.style: Polished early-2000s PS2 cutscene. Simple textures and game camera moves.
mutable: Brand link and logo in postproduction

shots.title: Personal greeting
shots.camera: Seated frontal medium close-up, small physical rail movement.
shots.action: Right hand rises beside shoulder, pauses in greeting, then returns to armrest. Eyes alert and on camera.
shots.line: Yo, {{BRAND_SPOKEN_NAME}}. Quick idea for your next drop.
shots.personalization: Brand-name voice and matching mouth animation.

shots.title: The setup
shots.camera: Hard cut to a distinct low, wide three-quarter position beside the table.
shots.action: Hands rest on thighs. He leans forward, plants both feet, then begins to rise. Hands remain clear of the torso.
shots.personalization: Category-specific setup. Time to the actual voice read.

shots.title: The cutscene payoff
shots.camera: Hard cut to a full-body frontal camera with chair behind him.
shots.action: Complete the rise from shot 02. Settle into a self-important protagonist stance, both arms at sides. Small eyebrow lift.

shots.title: The outfit
shots.camera: Hard cut to a standing three-quarter waist-up garment view.
shots.action: He squares his shoulders. Arms stay clear of chest. No garment tugging, pointing over the logo, or complex hand interaction.
shots.line: Your kit. Our character. A different kind of ad.
shots.personalization: Exact selected top and optional pants, rendered as PS2 assets.

shots.title: The system
shots.camera: Hard cut to standing frontal medium shot, gentle physical sideways track.
shots.action: One restrained open right-palm gesture below chest height, then hold.
shots.line: Same face. New scenes. Built around your brand.
shots.personalization: Same approved voice and character, no pricing or unverified claims.

shots.title: The brief
shots.camera: Hard cut to a tighter waist-up frontal camera.
shots.action: Small half-smile and one downward index indication. Stop after the CTA.
shots.line: The full idea's in the brief. Take a look.
shots.personalization: Add the actual brand brief link in postproduction and in the accompanying message.

production.brandSpeech: Separate approved voice and lip-sync stage for greeting and category lines. Genjutsu does not create the new spoken name.
production.clipStrategy: Six separate source shots, each below the API source limit. Re-time to measured voice. Keep base sources immutable, derive each brand from the neutral base.
production.swapStrategy: Test the hardest full-body shot with top only first. Add pants only after a passing review. Do not chain swaps from one brand to the next.
production.continuityReview: Check identity, garment SKU, logos, hands, occlusions, room geometry, shot joins, audio sync, and the final brief URL.
